Computing time estimates

Miquel De Cáceres (EMF-CREAF)

2026-10-16

Source: vignettes/modelanalysis/ComputingTime.Rmd
ComputingTime.Rmd

About this vignette

The aim of this vignette is to provide users with a rough estimation of computing times for simulation models included in package medfate.

The results presented here were obtained using 1 year of simulation with the example data sets on a laptop (32 GiB memory and Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 185H × 22) with Ubuntu Linux OS 26.04.1 LTS.

Table of computational times

Computational times were estimated using system.time(), are in seconds and are shown by package version.
